values.win: Led the fix for duplicate charges during retries. Errors at checkout fell from about 40 a day to 2, and support stopped seeing refund requests for it.

values.context: Webhook retries share a queue with new events, so one slow merchant delays everyone else. We need a fix before the holiday traffic.
values.decision: Give retries their own queue, with a limit per merchant. A shared queue with priorities was simpler, but it couldn’t stop one merchant from filling it.
